title: CorpusCase
description: The 'case.json' manifest of one golden-corpus case (spec.md §6). The plan and executed-plan text snapshots sit beside it as plan.txt and executed.txt; this document holds the halves that are assertions rather than snapshots.

description.description: What this case is evidence for, in one line.

values.description: The captured values the plan executes against, keyed by the paths a resolver would supply (spec.md §2.4). Offline: no transport runs.

also-compiled-from.description: A second input that MUST reach the same verdicts as 'input' — the two-path agreement check of spec.md §4.4. Its plan may differ; its result may not.

Input.title: Input
Input.description: What is compiled. Open vocabulary of kinds so later designs can add their own.

pact.description: For kind 'pact-interaction': the pact document (any supported version).

variant.description: The variant id to compile under (design 2.3). Absent compiles the shape unpinned.

ExpectedResult.title: ExpectedResult
ExpectedResult.description: The assertion half of a case: a diff here is a behaviour change, never an acceptable optimisation (spec.md §6.2).

mismatches.description: Every expected mismatch, in the plan's result form. A case that expects a mismatch and gets a different one has failed.

action.description: The action whose node produced the error, when one did.
